diagnostics.description: A blocked requirement does not identify an audit blocker.
A requirement lists the same audit blocker more than once.
An audit blocker identifier does not use the required A01 form.
A requirement declares blockers while its testability is not blocked.
The corpus format version is not supported by this runner.

The corpus file could not be read.
The requirement inventory contains no requirements.
A requirement identifier occurs more than once.
A requirement identifier is malformed or disagrees with its declared layer.
A requirement has no non-whitespace statement.
A candidate specification anchor is not a safe lowercase identifier.
A source path is absolute, empty, or contains parent traversal.
A requirement does not identify a source section.
The pinned specification commit is not 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
A requirement does not identify a conformance target.
A requirement lists the same conformance target more than once.
The instance is not valid JSON.
The instance file could not be read.

The schema is not valid JSON.

The schema file could not be read.

A suite artifact could not be read.

An entity marked kept has different requested and applied canonical identifiers.

An entity refusal disagrees with the routing outcome or reports an applied entity.
An entity substitution lacks explicit best-effort policy or the required authority.
